messages:
Nora (Content): Putting up the near-final launch blog draft with benchmark highlights + webinar CTA. Need fast passes: Legal on claims, Demand Gen on gating + HS fields, Growth on headline variants, Ops on staging test. Can we wrap by EOD? :hourglass:
Evan (Product): Paste the benchmark language here so I can confirm baseline and infra details.
Nora (Content): Draft line: "In our tests, Redwood Inference lowered per-token serving cost by as much as 43% versus a stock PyTorch FP16 baseline on 8k-context workloads; methodology linked below." Hero CTA: "See demo + register for the webinar".
Kara (Legal): Good to hedge with "in our tests". Please add the runbook link and list hardware, batch size, quantization in an appendix. Suggest swapping "as much as 43%" to "up to 43% in our tests" and add methodology link inline.
Rafi (Demand Gen): Recommend gating slides, making the recording public after. HubSpot snippet I need in the draft:
```
formId: "hs_launch_sep"
hiddenFields: ["utm_source","utm_campaign","product_interest","company_size"]
redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides"
```
Also need the webinar date to finalize promo windows.
Mira (Growth): Headline variants: (A) "Reduce inference cost, keep latency low" vs (B) "Reliable LLM inference for production". Add CTA UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=launch_sep so we can track source.
Tess (Ops): Proposed publish Mon 2026-09-14 09:00 PT; partner embargo 08:30 PT. I'll run a staging HS form test Fri 16:00 PT. Need final permalink and OG image.
Nora (Content): Timeline: lock copy Fri EOD; legal signoff Mon morning; demand-gen builds form Mon afternoon; ops preflight Fri; publish Mon 09:00 PT. Suggested permalink: /blog/redwood-inference-launch-2026. Open to feedback.
Kara (Legal): I'll sign off once the runbook link and appendix are live on the draft page. Also tweak the quality line to: "while maintaining comparable automated-evaluation metrics (see methodology)".
Evan (Product): Added hardware and exact command to the internal runbook: A10G cluster, pytorch_benchmark.sh --fp16 --no_xformers --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --seed 42. Noted quantization variants.
Rafi (Demand Gen): Modal copy: "Get the benchmark slides + ops checklist". I'll QA post-ops test.
Mira (Growth): Confirmed A/B. I'll load both headlines into CMS for the split test.
Tess (Ops): Staging HS form test scheduled Fri 16:00 PT; will post results here. publish-bot: Publish job queued: 2026-09-14T09:00:00-07:00 (blog/redwood-inference-launch-2026).
Nora (Content): Thanks all  Please react when your item is done so I can close the thread. :rocket:
